title: Perd Wai
notes: Editorial selection, independent of repository activity or star counts. Claims and screenshot checked against the public README on 2026-10-23: https://github.com/naiplawan/perd-wai#readme (docs/screenshots/desktop.png). The outcome describes implemented functionality, not measured adoption or impact.
description: A Thai-first café launch simulator for exploring costs, break-even sales and cash runway.
problemStatement: Aspiring café owners need to see how rent, setup costs and daily sales affect their opening plan.
solution: A bilingual planning flow with deterministic calculations, scenario comparisons and exportable forecasts.

value.contribution: Built the planning interface, calculation engine and forecast views, with Thai/English copy and browser-saved plans.
value.designDecision: Keep the forecast deterministic. Optional AI explains the calculated results but cannot change the numbers or the decision signal.
value.outcome: Founders can compare three scenarios, inspect a six-month forecast and export a plan. The tool is ready for user validation; market validation is still pending.

value.screenshotCaption: Planning interface with example assumptions; full screenshot includes the forecast.
